data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

PL Capital Advisors' most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CHMG and FNWD.

CHMG reported Q2 2026 net income of $8.8M versus -$6.5M a year earlier (sign change; percentage not meaningful) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/763563/000162828026054168/0001628280-26-054168-index.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
